messages.subject: [Example] Embedded knitr chunks in Rcpp.
parts:
Playing around a bit and thought others might find it interesting.

http://rpubs.com/Thell/knitRcpp

It seems that using `engine=Rcpp` won't capture the output of embedded R (it goes to the console) so I figured why not try making the embedded R readable by `read_chunk` and guess what... it works great!

Have fun!
